label: 12-literature
question: Is there published literature on file about AI radiology software failures? Cite PMIDs.
answer: Yes, stored literature on AI radiology software includes a 2023 analysis of false-negative and false-positive outcomes of computer-aided detection on brain metastasis (PMID 35943350) and a 2021 review of AI for breast cancer detection in mammography and digital breast tomosynthesis (PMID 32531273). Additional stored articles cover AI to diagnose ischemic stroke and identify large vessel occlusions (PMID 31594798) and AI-supported screen reading in the MASAI mammography screening trial (PMID 37541274).
